verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Anrok's API docs describe endpoints (customers, tax IDs, address resolution, etc.) and reference an openapi.yaml spec, but nothing indicates an interactive reference with runnable/try-it examples; probes even show that common interactive-doc artifacts (openapi.json, swagger.json, llms.txt) return 404. Missing for 10: any mention of a 'try it' console, code sandbox, or runnable request builder in the docs.
